name: tea

definition.en: a hot drink made by pouring boiling water on dried leaves
definition.tr: kurutulmuş yaprakların üzerine kaynar su dökülerek yapılan sıcak içecek
definition.de: ein heißes Getränk aus getrockneten Blättern und kochendem Wasser
definition.fr: une boisson chaude faite en versant de l'eau bouillante sur des feuilles séchées
definition.it: una bevanda calda fatta versando acqua bollente su foglie secche
definition.es: una bebida caliente hecha echando agua hirviendo sobre hojas secas

origin: Chinese (Min dialect) tê; Turkish çay comes from the Mandarin word chá

sentences.en: Would you like a cup of [tea]?
sentences.fr: Tu veux une tasse de thé ?

sentences.en: In Turkey people drink [tea] all day.
sentences.tr: Türkiye'de insanlar bütün gün çay içer.
sentences.de: In der Türkei trinkt man den ganzen Tag Tee.
sentences.fr: En Turquie, on boit du thé toute la journée.
sentences.it: In Turchia si beve tè tutto il giorno.
sentences.es: En Turquía se bebe té todo el día.

sentences.en: Let the [tea] brew for three minutes.
sentences.de: Lass den Tee drei Minuten ziehen.
sentences.fr: Laisse infuser le thé trois minutes.
sentences.it: Lascia in infusione il tè per tre minuti.
sentences.es: Deja reposar el té tres minutos.
